chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Sa'd bin Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Isa, from al-Qasim bin Yahya, from his grandfather al-Hasan bin Rashid, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever loves us while he is in a place that does not disgrace him, then he is from the special ones of Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, and what is the place that does not disgrace him? He said: He is not accused regarding his birth. - And in another report: He was not made a son of fornication -.

key_terms.خَاصَّةِ اللَّهِ: The special ones of Allah (referring to the pure/favored)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for a lover to be in a 'place that does not disgrace them' according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that true love for the Ahl al-Bayt requires not just internal devotion but also a status free from social stigma, specifically excluding those of illegitimate birth (walad zina). This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, highlights the Shia emphasis on lineage purity and social integrity as markers of authentic spiritual connection to the Imams. It underscores that external circumstances of birth can serve as indicators of one's standing within the community of true lovers.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin bin Muhammed bin Isa, from Qasem bin Yahya, from his grandfather, Hasan bin Rashid, from Ibn Bukair, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:

The one who loves us whilst he is in a place that does not disgrace him, then he is from what is made upright by Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, and what is the place that does not disgrace him? He said: He is not accused with regards to his birth. In another report: He was not made a son of fornication.
